method: Actually reopened each of the seven final release PNGs with view_image, after viewing the earlier process images. Image observations are not inferred from hashes. Native render stage is excluded from model; actual raw/native triangle equality is separately checked.

images.observation: Whole stadium framed; central field void and red outer ring visible; only west local canopy; no large intersection visible at whole-model scale.
Both stand halves, open field and short-end passages visible; continuous stepped ordinary ring and local west canopy distinguishable.
East projecting platform is visually separate from ordinary steps; no visible front-corner penetration at this overall scale; west field face visible across empty field.
Whole-model top view shows open central field, two short-end access gaps, west local roof and uncovered east projection. Native stage is not model field geometry.
West exterior has three deep large arches, four main pier masses, two urns and bracket/cornice bands; rear closures visible, not through-road proof.

Actually reopened final PNG after platform fix: three low bounded arches, front stone railing/platform, stepped seats, two urn towers and local flat canopy remain coherent. Continuous raised front connection is independently verified by top/underside triangle probes; no new low passage filling is inferred from image.
South short-end facade has broad rectangular central through opening, two small recessed arches and asymmetric appearance versus west gate; field beyond visible.

platform_fix_visual_context.observation: Prior interior field-face/core gap and middle-pier rear voids disappear from actual full projection. Remaining north wing corner, outer source-edge strip and small edge differences are bounded shape approximations, not verified courtyards or exact full-source occupancy.

limits: Modern metre elevations and precise row counts remain estimated.
Upper rear bridge construction is an explicit estimate, not a photo-resolved beam claim.
Views and checks do not certify interiors, public accessibility, a historical-state restoration, or completion of separate gym/pool.
Browser/global-map rendering is a separate QA responsibility.
